ValidationRule.description: Loss description must be filled when the opportunity is closed lost and the Loss Reason is 'Other'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Lost"), ISPICKVAL(pkl_LossReason__c, 'Other'), ISBLANK( txa_LossReasonDescription__c ), NOT($Permission.BypassValidations) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The loss reason description must be provided.
